metric_comparisons.comparison_notes: D2-006 requires out-of-sample Sharpe >= 1.0 net of modeled costs; OL-0032 records sharpe below that threshold.
D2-006 confidence posture requires DSR probability above 0.95 under current repo evaluator semantics; OL-0032 records dsr = 0.0.
D2-006 requires max drawdown <= 20% in any walk-forward fold; OL-0032 records max_drawdown above that threshold.
D2-006 requires parameter sensitivity min_ratio >= 0.70; OL-0032 records sensitivity_min_ratio below that threshold.
D2-006 requires walk-forward efficiency > 0.5; OL-0032 records walk_forward_efficiency below that threshold.
